sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate defines the required canonical cross-owner relationship path from the ship-owned structure to interpolationPoint; the available interpolationPoint term is a Class rather than that path property.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the owner/path structure: interpolationPoint has requiredOwner ship, but the candidate places both interpolationLowerEndpoint and interpolationUpperEndpoint nodes, and their coordinate/result constraints, under the obliquePlatingInterpolationCase.
